text:
claire: Quick design thread  chart legend + invoice CTA placement for the Usage overview. Two new ideas in Figma: integrated scope pill in chart subtitle vs. floating header CTA. Thoughts?
jord: Link to mock: https://www.figma.com/file/UNIQUE_MOCK
pm_liu: Finance note: we need a single, predictable place for the official PDF invoice. Customers expect it in the header or top-level controls.
tereza: UX idea: integrate a small scope pill (Org / Project Group / Project) into the chart subtitle. When clicked it becomes a dropdown that also surfaces "Download invoice" for the selected scope. Cleaner than extra header chrome and keeps context next to the data.
devin: Engineering caveat: making the pill open heavy actions (download, bulk export) from inside the chart area complicates z-index and chart redraws. Also analytics expect header CTAs for tracking clicks.
claire: Accessibility nit: pill must be keyboard-focusable and announce current scope and available actions, e.g., "Spend scope: Organization. Press Enter for actions." Avoid icon-only affordances.
a11y-bot: Recommend role=combobox or button with aria-expanded and an aria-controls menu. Ensure each menu item has clear labels: "Download invoice (Organization)" and "Export CSV (Project Group)". Also provide a table fallback for screen readers for the chart.
billing-bot: billing-bot: FYI customers use "Billing statement" interchangeably; legal insists on "Invoice" for official artifacts. CSV labeled as "Export CSV (tokens)" is fine.
jord: Another UX angle: keep a small persistent header CTA 'Download invoice' (primary) but move format choices into the scope pill dropdown. So header is discovery point and pill is contextual chooser.
tereza: That feels like the best of both worlds. Header CTA is visible for auditors; scope pill lets power users pick format and scope without leaving the chart.
devin: Implementation plan: header CTA (single-click PDF for Org) + scope pill dropdown that can trigger async batch generation for large sets. For per-project downloads show small inline kebab on row/card that lazily loads invoice metadata.
claire: Mobile behavior: header CTA stays sticky at top; pill becomes full-width control under chart; per-row kebab moves into row overflow menu.
pm_liu: Copy locked: header CTA = "Download invoice"; dropdown item = "Download invoice (PDF)"; secondary = "Export CSV (tokens)"; async job text = "Preparing invoices. We'll email you when ready." Legal approves.
a11y-bot: Also add aria-live confirmations: "Download started" and for async "Invoice generation started; you'll receive an email when ready." Add focus management for the dropdown and returned focus after action.
devin: Dev estimates: frontend 2.5d to implement header CTA + scope pill + kebab lazy-load; backend 1.5d for async batch job + signed links. I'll add tickets.
claire: Action items: devin update figma with pill + header combo; pm_liu to paste legal microcopy into spec; a11y-bot to produce acceptance checklist; devin to link backend ticket. I'll mark design-ready after mock + tickets linked. Thanks! :sparkles:
